## IA drift review — `05-stress-ia-drift`

12 findings, no high-severity. The drift clusters around three stories, not 12 independent issues.

### Blocking — fix before shipping IA changes

- **crime_00001 — Permission IA Drift** on `/admin` (medium, 0.59 agent_risk). Three role tokens (`admin`/`manager`/`owner`) across `src/nav.ts:6`, `src/routes/admin.ts:2,4,9`, and `docs/routes.md`. This is an **auth surface**; an agent editing one location leaves the others stale and the access policy becomes whichever check fires first. Centralise the check.
- **crime_00006 — Parallel Destination** (medium, 0.48). `src/routes/admin/billing-plans.ts` and `src/routes/billing-plans.ts` serve overlapping intent with no nav/doc/import link between them. An agent will edit one and miss the other.
- **crime_00004 — Concept Alias Drift** (medium, 0.51). `organisation`/`team`/`workspace` used as if interchangeable across `src/nav.ts`, `src/routes/organisation.ts`, `src/routes/teams.ts`, `src/routes/workspace.ts`, `src/components/TeamList.tsx`. This is the **root cause** under most of the orphans below — pick the canonical term first, then the cleanup of 00007–00010 mostly writes itself.

### Follow-ups — same milestone, lower urgency

- **crime_00007–00010 — Orphaned Destinations** (4× low, 0.39). `/admin/billing-plans`, `/billing-plans`, `/organisation`, `/workspace` are all unreachable. Cluster is signal: address them as the cleanup pass after resolving 00004 and 00006 — half will be deleted, half will be wired up, and that decision falls out of the alias call.
- **crime_00003 — Docs-Code Drift** (low, 0.53). `docs/routes.md:14 → /admin` is a stale link; sweep when fixing 00001.
- **crime_00005 — Docs Reference Missing Command** (low, 0.51). `docs/routes.md` mentions `iaq teams|workspace|refresh`; binary only advertises `get, list`. Pure doc rot.
- **crime_00002 — Missing Agent Context** (medium, 0.54). No `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`/`SKILL.md` and the repo ships an `iaq` bin. Real, but orthogonal to the IA review — separate ticket.
- **crime_00011 & crime_00012 — Action Label Drift / Copy IA Drift** (2× low, 0.38). `archive`/`delete`/`remove` scattered across `SeatList`/`TeamList`/`UserList`. **Note:** these two findings have identical evidence — looks like the same underlying signal surfaced through two detectors. Worth a glance at the detector to see if dedup is missing; on the fix side, treat them as one item.

### Bottom line

Three blocking items (00001, 00004, 00006) tell one coherent story: the IA forked around the tenant concept and admin permissions. Fix those and the four orphans collapse into cleanup. The rest is doc rot and copy polish — not blocking, but cheap enough to bundle in the same PR.
